desc: This culture considers conflict and violence to be necessary states of existence; ingrained in its people is the idea that one should stand up and fight for their own.
name: Bellicose

desc: No culture lasts longer than its oldest record, and this culture believes in accounting so meticulous as to guarantee immortality.
name: Bureaucratic

parameters.text: Rulers can adopt Administrative Government type as a King as well when they are Emperors

desc: The ceremony of court life is so integral to this culture that it forms a core part of people's social behavior. A place for everyone, and everyone in their place.
name: Ceremonious

desc: This culture values the bonds of community above all else, fostering great loyalty and dedication by working together towards common goals.
name: Communal

parameters.text: Herders have a higher County Fertility Growth

desc: Intolerance and isolationism may be the way for others, but this culture recognizes that accepting difference is far better than annihilating it.
name: Egalitarian

desc: While some cultures turn to war and others to worldly knowledge, this culture places its trust in the only constant throughout its history - the divine. Spirituality is the only way forward in a harsh and uncaring world.
name: Spiritual

parameters.text: Consult the Skies Decision has additional effects
Characters of this Culture have increased Stargazer Aptitude

desc: This culture believes in standing strong like a mountain, taking any and all hardships that life may throw at them and enduring them all with grim determination and an indomitable spirit.
name: Stoic
